status: exact bulk localization, terminal-collar recovery, cofinal RH-equivalence, and strict norm-separation guard

rows.statement: Retain N=2K+1, R=ceil(K^(1-alpha/2)), Delta_i=w_i-w_(i-1), B_i=A_i+beta for i<K, B_K=beta, E_B=sum_(i=1)^K Delta_i B_i^2, and H_K=sum_(i=1)^K B_i^2.
rows.proof_boundary: Here 0<alpha<1, K is dyadic, and K>=4.

rows.statement: For q_r=2r-1, sum_(r=h)^ell sin(q_r u)=sin((ell-h+1)u)sin((h+ell-1)u)/sin(u).
rows.proof_boundary: The formula holds for 0<u<pi and finite 1<=h<=ell.

rows.statement: For S_R(u)=sum_(r<=R)sin(q_r u)/q_r, |S_R(u)-pi/4|<=1/[(2R+1)sin(u)] on 0<u<pi.
rows.proof_boundary: This is Abel summation of the infinite odd-sine tail.

rows.statement: Set eta_R=arcsin(8/[pi(2R+1)]), L=ceil(N eta_R/pi), and J=min(K,K+2-L).
rows.proof_boundary: The minimum at K is required when L is one or two.

rows.statement: Writing a=pi/N, Delta_i for i<K is 2/N times the S_R integrals over [(K-1-i)a,(K-i)a] and [(K-2+i)a,(K-1+i)a], while Delta_K=(2/N)integral_(a)^(3a)S_R(u)du.
rows.proof_boundary: The endpoint formula uses S_R(pi-u)=S_R(u).

rows.statement: S_R(u)>=pi/8 throughout [eta_R,pi-eta_R].
rows.proof_boundary: No arithmetic coefficient enters this spectral bound.

rows.statement: Every 1<=i<=J has an interior sliver of length at least pi/N, hence Delta_i>=pi^2/(4N^2).
rows.proof_boundary: For L<=2 the endpoint sliver is included; otherwise J<K.

rows.statement: Q_J:=sum_(i=1)^J B_i^2 satisfies Q_J<=4N^2 E_B/pi^2.
rows.proof_boundary: This uses only positivity and the bulk increment lower bound.

rows.statement: Because B_i-B_(i+1)=u_i and |u_i|<=1, |B_(J+t)|<=|B_J|+t for 1<=t<=K-J.
rows.proof_boundary: The future anchor beta need not be bounded separately.
This is a deterministic bounded-increment inequality.
The terminal collar is the only loss in the reverse comparison.

rows.statement: The elementary arcsine chord bound gives L<=1+4N/[pi(2R+1)]<=1+2N/(pi R).
rows.proof_boundary: For R=ceil(K^(1-alpha/2)), L=O(K^(alpha/2)).

rows.statement: If E_B=O_delta(K^delta) for every delta>0 at a fixed alpha, then sum_(K dyadic)K^(-2-alpha)H_K is finite.
rows.proof_boundary: Choose delta<alpha/2; both collar terms are dyadically summable.

rows.statement: By MATBH.39, fixed-alpha all-epsilon subpower control of E_B implies R_alpha<infinity.
rows.proof_boundary: One fixed alpha gives only its shifted reciprocal-tail criterion.

rows.statement: If the E_B subpower condition holds for every member of one fixed cofinal sequence alpha_j->0+, then RH follows.
rows.proof_boundary: No alpha=0 or uniform-in-alpha passage is used.

rows.statement: Under RH, M(x)=O_delta(x^(1/2+delta)); partial summation gives beta_K=O_delta(K^(1/2+delta)) and B_i=O_delta(K^(1/2+delta)) uniformly in i.
rows.proof_boundary: The beta weight is monotone with uniformly bounded variation.

rows.statement: Under RH, H_K=O_delta(K^(2+delta)); PBSE.17 then gives E_B=O_delta(K^delta) for every delta>0.
rows.proof_boundary: The epsilon parameter is renamed after the square.

rows.statement: Along any fixed cofinal positive-alpha sequence, the all-epsilon E_B subpower condition is equivalent to RH.
rows.proof_boundary: This is a composition of the collar theorem and prior RH criteria.

rows.statement: Set u_(K-1)=-1, all other current u_i=0, put one future coefficient v_(2K)=1, and set all other future coefficients to zero.
rows.proof_boundary: All synthetic coefficients have modulus at most one.

rows.statement: For the terminal vector beta=1, B_i=0 for i<K, H_K=1, and E_B=Delta_K=c-w_(K-1)>0.
rows.proof_boundary: The witness isolates the endpoint anchor direction.

rows.statement: Spectral differencing gives 0<Delta_K<=8pi^2 R/N^3.
rows.proof_boundary: The bound uses |sin(2theta)sin(theta)|<=2theta^2 modewise.

rows.statement: For the terminal vector, K^2 E_B/H_K<=8pi^2 R K^2/N^3=O(R/K)->0.
rows.proof_boundary: Therefore no uniform E_B>=c K^(-2)H_K norm bound exists.

rows.statement: At alpha=1/2 and K=16,...,1024, every bulk increment exceeds the proved threshold and direct Mobius values give K^2 E_B/H_K near 2.35--2.47.
rows.proof_boundary: Finite values prove no asymptotic Mobius estimate.

rows.statement: E_B is strictly weaker as a finite-dimensional norm, but bounded coefficient increments recover its missing O(K^(alpha/2)) terminal collar at the cofinal theorem scale.
rows.proof_boundary: The boundary route is an RH-equivalent gate, not an easier shortcut.

rows.statement: Prove E_B=O_delta(K^delta) for every delta>0 on every dyadic scale and every member of one fixed cofinal positive-alpha sequence, without assuming RH.
rows.proof_boundary: This target is now explicitly calibrated as RH-equivalent.

rows.statement: The localization, collar recovery, cofinal composition, and synthetic norm-separation guard are exact.
rows.proof_boundary: No E_B estimate, Y projection estimate, RH, PF-infinity, Lambda<=0, or Clay-prize result is proved.
